evals.prompt: Build a local Python stdio MCP server for querying a ticketing system.
evals.expected_output: Verify current MCP spec and SDK version, use stdio transport with stdout strictly for protocol and stderr for logs, name tools <service>_<verb>_<resource> in snake_case, set accurate tool hints, and test with MCP Inspector.
expectations: Routes all diagnostic logging to stderr and keeps stdout protocol-clean
Defines strict input schemas and tests schema rejection and pagination

evals.prompt: Add a destructive delete tool to an existing TypeScript Streamable HTTP MCP server.
evals.expected_output: Validate HTTP Origin and DNS rebinding protection, enforce authorization inside the operation, require explicit target identifiers, mark destructiveHint: true, and keep credentials out of output.
expectations: Validates Origin and authorization at the server boundary
Marks destructiveHint: true and requires explicit target identifiers
Does not expose stack traces or secrets in error responses
